name: cuda-programming
description: Use when the user asks about a CUDA kernel, nvcc, shared memory tiling, coalesced access, warp divergence, occupancy, CUDA streams or __syncthreads. Produces CUDA C++ kernels with launch config, error checking and an Nsight Compute profiling plan. Not for Triton kernels (use triton-kernels) or PTX/SASS reading (use ptx-assembly).

findings.excerpt: nvcc -O3 -arch=sm_90 -lineinfo -o app app.cu        # -lineinfo maps SASS to source in Nsight
